## Activity

Central Eye Clinic recorded 217 captures during March 2024. Activity was completed through the planned clinic sessions, with routine leave managed within the existing arrangements. The recorded volume provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading performance for the month. No change to the scheduled operating arrangements was noted in the monthly return.

## Image quality

Of the 217 captures, 2 were recorded as ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 0.9. The result indicates that most captures were suitable for assessment. The ungradable captures should continue to be reviewed through routine quality assurance so that any recurring issues with image acquisition can be identified and addressed. Overall, image availability supported the grading activity reported for the month.

## Grading

Grading identified 57 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 3. This measure should be considered alongside the monthly activity and image-quality results when monitoring service performance. The reported grading output reflects the completed work associated with the month’s captures and provides a clear basis for ongoing operational review. Further monitoring should focus on maintaining the current turnaround and ensuring that all suitable captures continue to progress through grading.
